mapper.sql: id, connection_id, connect_timeout, keepalive_interval, startup_command, strict_host_key_check, compression, known_hosts, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ssh_connection_config (connection_id, connect_timeout, keepalive_interval, startup_command, strict_host_key_check, compression, known_hosts) VALUES (#{connectionId}, #{connectTimeout}, #{keepaliveInterval}, #{startupCommand}, #{strictHostKeyCheck}, #{compression}, #{knownHosts})
mapper.update: UPDATE ssh_connection_config SET connect_timeout = #{connectTimeout}, keepalive_interval = #{keepaliveInterval}, startup_command = #{startupCommand}, strict_host_key_check = #{strictHostKeyCheck}, compression = #{compression}, known_hosts = #{knownHosts} WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId}
UPDATE ssh_connection_config SET strict_host_key_check = 1 WHERE strict_host_key_check = 0
